description: Look up an airport by IATA or ICAO code and get its name, city, country, ISO 3166-2 region code, WGS-84 coordinates, elevation and IANA time zone, or find the nearest airports to a coordinate within a radius. Covers every airport worldwide that holds a three-letter IATA code and scheduled service. Returns the code type that matched and the distance in kilometres for proximity results. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

code.description: 3-letter IATA or 4-letter ICAO code, case-insensitive. Accepted: a 3-letter IATA or 4-letter ICAO code.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter. Accepted: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

limit.description: Maximum results 1-25, default 5. Only with near. Accepted: integer 1-25.

near.description: lat,lon to search around. Accepted: lat,lon.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km, 1-1000, default 100. Only with near. Accepted: number 1-1000.

name: ref_airport
title: Airport lookup by IATA or ICAO code with coordinates and elevation
